text_block_list.text:
One day, Gold Ship said she wanted to go 
shopping, so we came to the shopping 
district together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I managed to snag some "Space 
Macarons: Sesame Miso Flavor".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The "Yurinchi Chicken Flavor" and "Braised 
Egg Flavor" sounded good too, so maybe 
I'll come back and buy them next time—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, what's that? It's pretty noisy over 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a lottery raffle, they say!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I got a piece of 
paper along with the macarons earlier. Is 
that one of those lottery tickets?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go all out and aim straight 
for the consolation prize!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Pops from the shopping district! 
What's the consolation prize? Candy? A 
whip? An iron ball!?"

With daring courage, aiming straight for 
the booby prize, Gold Ship spun the 
lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: T-The grand priiiize...?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious!? This isn't a consolation 
prize at aaalll!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I really went and won it... a hot springs 
ticket.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I said I was aiming for the consolation 
prize, but getting it actually makes me 
super happy...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring, huh... I could just go by 
myself, but—ah!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I got it! If I make clones of myself, 
that means twice the fun, doesn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then there's only one thing to do! Here I 
goooooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Di-vi-sion!! Personality Split-ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*, *gasp*... ――I 
failed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To think that the all-knowing, almighty 
Godshi can't even make shadow clones...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Guess I've got no choice. I'll 
entrust this hot spring trip voucher to 
you for now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Until I've completely mastered shadow 
clones, please keep that stored away where 
I can't see it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, otherwise I'd end up using it 
without even being able to make clones... 
gah!"

I don't know if the day will ever come 
where Gold Ship learns shadow cloning, but 
I decided to hold onto the hot springs 
ticket just as she asked.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a carrot hamburg steak!? Looks like I 
pulled something pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Today's dinner is a super juicy skirt 
steak, so this makes for a perfect 
dessert—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait a sec? Could this be a chance 
to create a new flavor of "Space 
Macarons"?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First, I eat the carrot hamburger steak, 
right? And then I give my review, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And then, we send that food review to the 
'Space Macaron' manufacturer, Space 
Gourmet Factory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Do that, and the dev team will be so moved 
that the "Space Macaron: Carrot Salisbury 
Steak Flavor" will be born!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that that's decided, time for 
some food reporting! Follow me!

To create a new flavor of "Space Macaron," 
I decided to research carrot hamburg 
steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's an insane amount of carrots. 
What should I do with these...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now that I think about it, I have 
landlady training at a traditional inn 
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect! I'll practice my decorative 
carrot carving on these guys!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've mastered everything from flowers, 
stars, and butterflies, to full-blown 
Gothic architecture—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna earn a double circle 
from the active proprietress!"

Afterward, I watched over Gold Ship back 
at the dorm as she practiced decorative 
vegetable carving.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, 3rd prize! And it's just a single 
carrot...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's not a consolation prize, but it ain't 
the grand prize either. Honestly, I don't 
know how to react... but still!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When you think about how that single piece 
of paper can turn into a carrot, it's 
practically a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, slip of paper! Thank you, 
carrots! Let us take this moment to 
reflect upon the sanctity of food once 
again!

Talking all the way home about how 
grateful we were for just a single carrot, 
the two of us headed back.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Here it is, the consolation prize—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, tissues?! What happened to the 
whip or the wrecking ball?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, do you know what happens when 
you make a paper airplane out of tissue 
paper?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Some say it shockingly won't fly at all, 
while others say it's so light it'll never 
return to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's go check for ourselves to see what 
the real truth is.

Gold Ship drew a consolation prize, but it 
didn't seem to be the prize she was hoping 
for.
